verses.html: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.title: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
verses.text: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

verses.html: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.text: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

verses.html: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.text: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

verses.html: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.text: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

verses.html: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.text: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

verses.html: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
verses.text: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
